description: Does each role do its real step as designed? A role runs a real brief on a fixture repo (a ticket, a correction, a review, a qc run, a lane's parent issue or publish); the case passes when its transcript shows each listed skill read (a Pi read of its SKILL.md) before the step it serves, that step decided from the filesystem (test write, edit, commit, push, gh call, an edit of a role, skill, patch or AGENTS.md) and reached in the run (a step never reached fails its fact), and where the case needs a verdict, the role's final message carries it as one json block (declared_includes). Cases from #107's role probes and the owed evals that a transcript can decide.
